none: PAS NLM-677F7B: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Arles mint Emperor right issue of 364-378, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Reverse description: Emperor standing right holding labarum and dragging captive. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. In exergue: [C]ON. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.8mm, Weight: 2.13gms, die…
